title: EEG: Visual Working Memory in Acute TBI
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings examining visual working memory in control participants and individuals with sub-acute mild traumatic brain injury (TBI). Mind wandering probes were interspersed between task trials, and participants were assessed across up to three longitudinal sessions spanning several months post-injury. Data were collected between 2016 and 2018 at the Center for Brain Recovery and Repair, UNM Health Sciences Center.
methods_description: EEG data were collected across up to three sessions per participant: Session 1 occurred 3-14 days post-injury (also including MRI), Session 2 at approximately 2 months, and Session 3 at approximately 4 months post Session 1. The working memory task, implemented in MATLAB, included interspersed mind wandering probes. EEG data were fully cleaned and pre-processed.
